log_config_to_file: log an EasyDict config object recursively to a logger with dotted key paths
cfg_from_list: set config keys from a command-line argument list with dot-notation key paths
merge_new_config: recursively merge a new config dict into an existing EasyDict config with base config support
cfg_from_yaml_file: load and merge a YAML config file into an existing EasyDict config object
review_config_module: review the config module functions for loading YAML configs and merging nested EasyDict settings
